description: Get Confirmation On Upload Through Signed URL. Part of the Upload APIs in Giddh. Requires Auth-Key or Session-Id.

branchUniqueName.description: Branch uniqueName; omit for default company branch behaviour. Optional.

type.description: Voucher or entity type discriminator for the list. Allowed values: TALLY_MASTERS, TALLY_ENTRIES, MASTER_IMPORT, ENTRIES_IMPORT, INVENTORY_IMPORT, BANK_TRANSACTIONS_IMPORT, CONVERT_FILE, ACCOUNT_WISE_VOUCHER_IMPORT, VOUCHER_WISE_VOUCHER_IMPORT, DOCUMENT_IMPORT, MAIL_BANK_TRANSACTIONS_IMPORT. Mandatory.

isHeaderProvided.description: Is header provided query parameter. Default: true. Optional.

voucherType.description: Voucher type for recurring or list APIs. Optional.

sameDebitCreditAmountColumn.description: Same debit credit amount column query parameter. Optional.
